services.desc: When you’re serious about tuna fishing, there’s only one place to go: the Other Side of the Gulfstream. Cocoa Beach Sportfishing specializes in offshore expeditions targeting Yellowfin and Blackfin Tuna in waters where few anglers venture. Departing from Port Canaveral, we make the run across the Gulfstream to reach untouched fishing grounds rich with pelagic gamefish-including Marlin, Wahoo, and Mahi. The journey takes just over 2 hours, and we plan every trip to put you on the water at first light when tuna are most active. blurb: Guests experience offshore fishing in the waters off Cocoa Beach and Cape Canaveral, targeting species like mahi-mahi, sailfish, marlin, kingfish, wahoo, sharks, grouper, snapper, and more. Trips include half-day reef and nearshore excursions as well as full-day offshore charters. Specialized trips include deep dropping for bottom fish and shark fishing targeting various shark species.
